NONE: › used to represent the second of two numbers or names that are not known or stated, when the first is represented by "x"
未知（或未指明）的數（或名稱）（在兩個未知或未指明的數或名稱中，當第一個用x代替時，y用來代替第二個）
› added to nouns to form adjectives meaning like the stated thing
（加在名詞之後構成形容詞）像…的，似…的

example: The children on trial were referred to as child X and child Y.
受試兒童被稱作兒童X和兒童Y。
